snippet.title: PETSCOP: Restored [PS1 Homebrew] [BETA-DEMO v1.0]
snippet.description:
Game link:
https://nitroyuash.itch.io/petscop-restored

Happy Halloween, internet!
I was planning to recreate Petscop on a real PS1 hardware, but realized that it's not playing well. Instead, I recreated it on a real PS1 hardware AND adds a new content and remade questionable puzzles. This will not be a 100% recreation of the original.

Modding support. RSEngine SDK included. Some assets were cut out, because they were taken from Giftscop recreation (with permission).

"PETSCOP: Restored" is a non-profit project! I will not being making money off of it. But you still can support my engine :)
Boosty: https://boosty.to/nitroyuash (RSEngine, SDK Software)
Patreon: https://patreon.com/nitroyuash (RSEngine, SDK Software)
https://twitter.com/nitroyuash (News)
https://discord.gg/C6UQWFsKD7 (News and experimental builds)

Petscop OST:
https://petscop.bandcamp.com/
